title: Twist Bioscience
summary: South San Francisco company synthesising DNA at scale for drug discovery and synthetic biology.
bodyHtml:
Twist Bioscience writes DNA using a semiconductor-based synthesis process, selling synthetic genes, oligo pools and antibody libraries to research and pharmaceutical customers.

Its platform underpins AI-guided protein engineering and synthetic biology workflows that need large numbers of designed sequences.

Why it matters

  • High-throughput DNA synthesis
  • Synthetic genes and libraries
  • Antibody discovery

businessMeaning: Every generative-biology programme ends in a physical DNA order. Synthesis capacity is a bottleneck that sits upstream of the AI design boom.
investmentLens: A listed tool provider whose revenue tracks research budgets and biotech funding.
